training_receipt.selection: maximum validation image-mean hidden IoU; full IoU breaks exact ties; no benchmark or holdout checkpoint selection

shape_policy.seed_rule: sha256(surface-progressive-v1:target:iteration:slot); first 8 little-endian bytes modulo 2**63-1 (same seeds as legacy shape)
shape_policy.observation: original visible RGB and mask only; neutralize all other RGB before resizing
shape_policy.crop: square visible bounding box, padding 2.0; zero probability outside this box
shape_policy.unknown: all non-visible pixels, matching training; no occluder constraint
shape_policy.projection: native probability into current PMC crop, bilinear resize; visible pixels set to 1
shape_policy.selection: maximum expected mask IoU; exclude empty masks; first seed wins ties; slot 0 fallback
shape_policy.candidate_matching: highest IoU with original visible support; require positive overlap

input_policy: Only original visible RGB/mask; no hidden RGB, amodal mask or truth-based crop
metric_frame: full native source image including truth outside visible-based model crop
